name: @frontguard/mcp
description: Pre-release Frontguard MCP server for querying a verified cloud API deployment. No default hosted endpoint is live.

env.name: FRONTGUARD_API_URL
env.description: Verified Frontguard API deployment URL. No default hosted endpoint is live.

tools.name: list_regressions
tools.description: Return the visual regressions Frontguard detected on a given GitHub PR (or run id). Each row carries a `diffId` you can pass to `get_suggested_fix`.

tools.name: list_horizontal_overflow
tools.description: List horizontal overflow from a run. A flagged row is a visible unclipped box past the right edge, with selector and pixels. scrollWidth and innerWidth are recorded. This does not change the pixel result or the exit code.

tools.name: get_suggested_fix
tools.description: Return the AI-generated patch for a single diff (keyed by the `diffId` from `list_regressions`).

tools.name: accept_baseline
tools.description: Record run-scoped whole-run approval after `confirm_all_regressions_reviewed: true`. Screenshot promotion is not implemented yet; use the CLI or composite Action to update baselines.

tools.name: recent_runs
tools.description: List the most recent runs the API key has access to. Optional `repo` and `branch` filters narrow the results.

tools.name: inspect_diff_cluster_dom
tools.description: Inspect a specific visual regression diff cluster, returning its bounding box, AI classification, suggested fix, and grounded DOM target selector.

tools.name: verify_css_patch
tools.description: Validate a candidate CSS patch against a visual regression diff for syntax correctness, target selector alignment, and layout-destroying properties.

tools.name: promote_baseline
tools.description: Promote reviewed visual changes to baseline after `confirm_reviewed: true`, optionally scoped to specific routes.
